transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess… work got out of hand. I was starting all these plant redesign projects, calling suppliers after hours, rewriting the shift plan myself. And then suddenly I couldn’t keep up with any of it, even though I’d set it all in motion.
Have you lost interest or felt less pleasure in things you used to enjoy, like hobbies or time with family and friends?
I don’t know. I haven’t really been paying attention to that. Work’s been taking up most of my headspace, I guess.
Have you been feeling down or losing interest in things for most of the day, more days than not, over the past couple of weeks?
Yeah… most mornings lately I wake up in the temporary apartment and it just feels… heavy. Like the day’s already gone bad before I even get to the plant.
Have you been feeling fatigued or lacking energy most days lately?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t been keeping track of that. I mean… some days feel hard to get through, but I don’t know if I’d call it lack of energy most days.
Have you noticed a decrease in your interest or enjoyment in activities you used to like, such as hobbies, work tasks, or time with people?
I’m… not sure. I haven’t really been doing much outside of work, so it’s hard to tell if I’m not enjoying things or just not making time for them.
Would you say that most days lately, you’ve been feeling down or depressed?
Yeah… I think so. Most days I wake up and there’s this heavy, kind of hollow feeling, like the day’s already ruined before I even leave for the plant.
Have you been feeling like you’re not good enough or blaming yourself for things more than usual lately?
I don’t know… maybe sometimes. I’m pretty hard on myself anyway, so it’s hard to tell if it’s more than usual.
Have you noticed that you’re not getting the same interest or pleasure out of things you used to care about, like work, hobbies, or seeing people, even when you do have time for them?
I’m still not really sure. I mean… I don’t do much with people or hobbies lately, so it’s hard to separate not enjoying it from just not really trying. Work is just work.
Would you say that your low mood is present most of the day, nearly every day, rather than just coming and going?
Yeah… it’s there most of the day. I wake up in the apartment with that heavy, hollow feeling, like the day’s already kind of ruined before I even drive to the plant.
Can you think of something you used to enjoy, like a hobby or seeing friends, and whether you’ve noticed yourself not caring about it as much lately—even when you do have time for it?
I’m not sure. I can’t think of one specific thing right now. I mostly just… don’t end up doing much, so it’s hard to say if I don’t care or if I’m just not making the effort.
When you do have time for things like hobbies or seeing friends, do you find that you don’t get the same enjoyment out of them as you used to?
I don’t really know. I haven’t been doing enough of those things lately to tell if I’d enjoy them or not.
When you do have time for things like hobbies or seeing friends, do you notice that you don’t feel interested in them or get pleasure from them the way you used to?
I… I don’t really know. I haven’t paid close enough attention, I guess. It’s more like I just don’t get around to doing those things much, so it’s hard to tell.
When you do take part in activities, like hobbies or spending time with people, do you find that you don’t feel interested in them or get as much pleasure from them as you used to?
I’m honestly not sure. I haven’t really noticed it clearly either way… I just don’t do much of that lately, so it’s hard for me to compare.
Can you think of something you used to enjoy doing, like a hobby or seeing friends, and whether you still feel the same pleasure in it when you do it now?
I can’t really think of a clear example. I mean… maybe there are things I used to do, but I haven’t done them enough lately to know if it feels different.
Can you think of something you used to enjoy doing — even something small — where you’ve noticed that when you do it now, it just doesn’t feel the same or you don’t care about it as much anymore?
I’m still not sure. I can’t really point to one thing and say, yes, that feels different now. I just… haven’t been paying attention to it that way, I guess.

Can you think of even a small activity or moment — maybe something like reading, watching a show, or talking to someone — where you’ve noticed that you don’t feel the same interest or enjoyment in it anymore when you actually do it?
I don’t know… not really. I can’t think of a specific moment like that. If I watch something or talk to someone, I’m usually not paying close enough attention to whether I’m enjoying it or not.
Can you think of any activity — even something small — where you’ve noticed that when you do it now, it just doesn’t feel as interesting or enjoyable as it used to?
I still can’t really think of one. Nothing specific comes to mind where I’d say, “that used to feel good and now it doesn’t.” I’m not sure I’ve noticed it that clearly.
Can you think of any activity — even something small — where you’ve noticed that when you do it now, you clearly don’t feel the same interest or enjoyment in it anymore, even while you’re doing it?
I really don’t know. I’m not trying to be difficult, I just… I can’t name something where it’s that clear to me. Nothing comes to mind like that.
Can you think of any activity — even something small — where you’ve noticed that when you do it now, you clearly don’t feel the same interest or enjoyment in it anymore, even while you’re doing it?
I don’t think I can give you a clear example. I’ve thought about it, but nothing really stands out that way.
